% !!! GENERATED FILE: edit _build/templates/cv.tex (layout) or data-ajsteinmetz/data/*.yml (content), then run `python build.py --pdf` in data-ajsteinmetz.
<# Jinja template with custom delimiters (see make_env in data-ajsteinmetz/build.py); `r` is the LaTeX renderer. #>
<% set updated = profile.updated ~ '' %>
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[margin=0.7in]{geometry}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{comment}
\PassOptionsToPackage{hyphens}{url}
\usepackage[colorlinks=true,linkcolor=blue,citecolor=blue,urlcolor=blue]{hyperref}
\urlstyle{same}
\usepackage[shortlabels]{enumitem}
\usepackage{longtable}
\linespread{0.95}
\setlength{\parskip}{0.5em}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}

\usepackage{hyperxmp}
\hypersetup{
  pdftitle   = {Steinmetz CV << updated >>},
  pdfauthor  = {Andrew J. Steinmetz},
  pdfsubject = {Curriculum Vitae},
  pdfkeywords = {
    Physics, Spin Dynamics, Magnetism, Neutrinos, Relativistic Quantum Mechanics, Quark-Gluon Plasma, Curriculum Vitae, Andrew Steinmetz
  },
  pdfproducer = {LaTeX with pdfTeX},
  pdfcreator  = {Andrew J. Steinmetz},
  colorlinks = true,
  urlcolor   = blue,
  linkcolor  = blue
}

\begin{document}

\pdfbookmark[0]{<< profile.name >>, << profile.credential >> -- Curriculum Vitae}{cv-top}

\begin{center}
    {\Large\textbf{<< profile.name >>, << profile.credential >>}}\\[0.5em]
    {\large Curriculum Vitae -- Last Updated << r.date_long(updated) >>}
\end{center}

{\normalsize
\begin{center}
    \begin{tabular}{@{}p{2.0cm} p{5.5cm} p{2.0cm} p{5.5cm}@{}}
        \textbf{Email:} & \href{mailto:<< profile.email >>}{<< profile.email >>} &
        \textbf{Website:} & \href{<< profile.website >>}{<< profile.website >>} \\
        \textbf{LinkedIn:} & \href{<< profile.links.linkedin >>}{linkedin.com/in/ajsteinmetz} &
        \textbf{ORCID:} & \href{https://orcid.org/<< profile.orcid >>}{<< profile.orcid >>} \\
    \end{tabular}
\end{center}
}

\medskip


\pdfbookmark[1]{Employment}{employment}
{\Large\textbf{Employment}}

{\normalsize
\begin{tabular}{@{}p{3.8cm} p{4.4cm} p{5.3cm} p{3.0cm}@{}}
    \toprule
    \textbf{Position Title} & \textbf{Department} & \textbf{Institution} & \textbf{Dates} \\
    \midrule
<% for e in employment %>
    << r.text(e.title) >><< r.fn(e.footnotes) if e.footnotes is defined >> & << r.text(e.department_short | default(e.department)) >> & << r.text(e.institution) >> & {\small << r.span(e.start, e.get('end'), r.mon_year) >>} \\
<% endfor %>
    \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
}

<< r.fnlist() >>

\medskip

\pdfbookmark[1]{Education}{education}
{\Large\textbf{Education}}

{\normalsize
\begin{tabular}{@{}p{2.8cm} p{5.0cm} p{5.5cm} p{3.2cm}@{}}
    \toprule
    \textbf{Degree} & \textbf{Field} & \textbf{Institution} & \textbf{Dates} \\
    \midrule
<% for e in education %>
    << e.degree >> & << r.text(e.field) >> & << r.text(e.institution) >><< r.fn(e.footnotes) if e.footnotes is defined >> & << r.mon_year(e.date) >> \\
<% endfor %>
    \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
}

<< r.fnlist() >>

\medskip

\pdfbookmark[1]{Research Interests}{research-interests}
{\Large\textbf{Research Interests}}

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,nosep]
<% for ri in profile.research_interests %>
    \item \textbf{<< r.text(ri.label) >>:} << r.text(ri.text) >>
<% endfor %>
\end{itemize}

\medskip

<% set diss = pubs.dissertation[0] %>
\pdfbookmark[1]{Dissertation}{dissertation}
{\Large\textbf{Dissertation}}

\textbf{Title:} << r.text(diss.title) >>\\[0.3em]
\textbf{Committee:} <% for c in diss.committee %>Prof.~<< r.esc(c.name) >>~(<< c.role >>)<< ", " if not loop.last >><% endfor %>\\[0.3em]
\textbf{Identifiers:} << r.pub_ids(diss) | join(', ') >>\\[0.3em]
\textbf{Presentation:} << r.ident(diss.presentation_doi, 'https://doi.org/' ~ diss.presentation_doi) >>

\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{1.0pt}

\pdfbookmark[1]{Publications}{publications}
{\Large\textbf{Publications}}

Citations = << profile.metrics.citations >>; h-index = << profile.metrics.h_index >> (\href{<< profile.links.scholar >>}{<< profile.metrics.source >>}, << r.mon_year(profile.metrics.as_of) >>). See also \href{<< profile.links.inspire >>}{INSPIRE-HEP} and \href{<< profile.links.arxiv >>}{arXiv}.

<% macro publist(title, bookmark, items) %>
\pdfbookmark[2]{<< title | replace('\\&', 'and') >>}{<< bookmark >>}
{\large\textbf{<< title >>}}

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*,nosep]
<% for p in items %>
    \item << r.cite(p) >>
<% endfor %>
\end{enumerate}
<% endmacro %>
<< publist('Peer-Reviewed Journal Articles', 'peer-reviewed-journal-articles', pubs.journal) >>
\medskip

<< publist('Book Chapters \\& Review Articles', 'book-chapters-review-articles', pubs.chapter) >>
\medskip

<< publist('Institutional \\& Technical Reports', 'institutional-technical-reports', pubs.report) >>
\medskip

<< publist('Works in Progress', 'works-in-progress', pubs['in-prep']) >>
\medskip

\pdfbookmark[1]{Conference Presentations and Talks}{conference-presentations-talks}
{\Large\textbf{Conference Presentations \& Talks}}

\pdfbookmark[2]{Talks Presented by Steinmetz}{talks-presented-by-steinmetz}
{\large\textbf{Talks Presented by Steinmetz, A.}}

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*,nosep]
<% for t in talks.presented %>
    \item << r.talk(t) >>
<% endfor %>
\end{enumerate}

\pdfbookmark[2]{Talks Co-Prepared by Steinmetz}{talks-co-prepared-by-steinmetz}
{\large\textbf{Talks Co-Prepared by Steinmetz, A. (Presented by Others)}}

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*,nosep]
<% for t in talks.co_prepared %>
    \item << r.talk(t) >>
<% endfor %>
\end{enumerate}

\noindent In addition, I have closely collaborated on preparing research and academic talks delivered at the following conferences/institutes: <% for c in talks.collaborated %><< r.text(c) >><< ', ' if not loop.last >><% endfor %>.

\medskip

\pdfbookmark[1]{Grants and Awards}{grants-awards}
{\Large\textbf{Grants \& Awards}}

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,nosep]
<% for a in awards %>
    \item << r.award(a) >>
<% endfor %>
\end{itemize}

\medskip

\pdfbookmark[1]{Teaching Experience}{teaching-experience}
{\Large\textbf{Teaching Experience}}

\textbf{Key:} <% for k in profile.institution_key %><< k.key >> (<< r.text(k.short | default(k.name)) >>)<< ", " if not loop.last >><% endfor +%>

<% macro course_table(g, first) %>
\pdfbookmark[2]{Faculty Courses at << g.key | replace('/', ' and ') >>}{faculty-courses-<< g.id >>}
\textbf{Faculty Courses at << g.key >> (as << g.role >>)<< r.fn('teaching-record') if first >>:}\\
{\normalsize
\begin{tabular}{@{}p{2.5cm} p{6.0cm} p{2.0cm} p{2.0cm} p{3.0cm}@{}}
    \toprule
    \textbf{Course \#} & \textbf{Title} & \textbf{Sections} & \textbf{Students} & \textbf{Semester} \\
    \midrule
<% for c in g.courses %>
    << c.code >> & << r.text(c.title) >><< r.fn(c.footnotes) if c.footnotes is defined >> & << c.sections >> & << r.students(c) >> & << c.term >> \\
<% endfor %>
    \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
}
<% endmacro %>

<< course_table(teaching_groups.gt, true) >>
<< course_table(teaching_groups['ua-act'], false) >>
<< r.fnlist() >>

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,nosep]
<% for gid in ['pcc', 'ua-ta'] %>
<% set g = teaching_groups[gid] %>
    \item \textbf{<< r.text(g.summary_heading) >>:} <% for label, yrs in r.teaching_summary(g) %><< label >> (<< yrs >>)<< ", " if not loop.last >><% endfor %>

<% endfor %>
\end{itemize}

\medskip

{\Large\textbf{Academic Service \& Associations}}

\pdfbookmark[2]{Institutional Committees and Appointments}{institutional-committees-appointments}
{\large\textbf{Institutional Committees \& Appointments}}

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*,nosep]
